dedupe_keys.name: taiwan water corporation statistical yearbook 台灣自來水事業統計年報

description: The statistical yearbook of the Taiwan Water Corporation reports each year on the public water supply the corporation runs for most of Taiwan outside Taipei. The yearbook page read on 2026-09-28 lists annual editions with their publication dates, each on 30 April or close to it, from the edition for ROC year 109 (2020) to the edition for year 114 (2025, published 30 April 2026), each with a PDF download and a detail page; utility yearbooks of this kind give production and supply volumes, population served, pipe network length, customers, non-revenue water and finances by district. Coverage is national, for the corporation's service areas, annually. Access is free as PDF files in Chinese; no licence is named. Caveats: the tables are in PDF and must be transcribed, the page itself does not describe the contents, and Taipei and Kinmen water supply are run by other utilities. It supports capacity planning and resilience analysis of Taiwan's water supply, for example drought periods and outage recovery, the site also offering water outage and drought information. No related Taiwan water record is catalogued yet.
